'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 western Russia attacks]]
***[[Russia]] says that it destroyed three [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] over [[Moscow]], which injured one person, prompting officials to close the [[Vnukovo International Airport]] to traffic. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jul/30/moscow-buildings-damaged-in-overnight-drone-attacks-that-russia-blames-on-kyiv (AFP via ''The Guardian'')]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**[[2023 Khar bombing]]
***At least 56 people are killed and nearly 200 others are injured in a [[Suicide attack|suicide bombing]] at a [[Jamiat Ulema-e-Islam (F)]] rally in [[Khar, Bajaur|Khar]], [[Bajaur District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/7/30/deadly-bomb-blast-at-political-rally-in-northwest-pakistan (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/pakistan-attentats-bilan-idFRKBN2ZC2AK Reuters]
*[[Sinai insurgency]]
**At least four officers are killed and at least 21 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at a police facility in [[Arish]], [[North Sinai Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/07/31/At-least-four-officers-dead-in-shooting-at-police-facility-in-Egypt-s-Sinai-Peninsula (AP via Al Arabiya)] 
*Five people are killed and seven others are injured in clashes in the [[Ain al-Hilweh]] [[Palestinian refugee camps|Palestinian refugee camp]] in [[Sidon District]], [[Lebanon]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/1-killed-6-wounded-overnight-clashes-crowded-palestinian-101847422 (AP via ABC News)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Spanish government]] researchers identify 357 missing [[International response to the Spanish Civil War|foreign fighters]] from the [[Spanish Civil War]], specifically from the [[International Brigades]], with most of the fighters from [[German involvement in the Spanish Civil War|Germany]], [[Austrian Armed Forces|Austria]], and the [[Netherlands Armed Forces|Netherlands]]. [https://apnews.com/article/spain-civil-war-international-brigades-catalonia-identified-5edeeac5a9155cab143b75e4cfc560ce (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*A 20-meter-long inflatable attraction in the amusement park "Wonderland Waterpark" in [[Saint-Maximin-la-Sainte-Baume]], [[France]], blows away, killing a 35-year-old man and severely injuring his 3-year-old daughter. [https://nos.nl/artikel/2484931-opblaaskussen-frans-pretpark-waait-weg-man-dood-dochtertje-zwaargewond (NOS)]
*Ten people are killed and 76 others are injured by severe [[storm]]s in parts of central [[Russia]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66354444 (BBC News)]
*Three people are killed and 37 others are injured in a [[traffic collision|collision]] between a bus and a truck in [[El Dabaa]], [[Matrouh Governorate]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/505694/Egypt/Urban--Transport/-dead,--injured-in-bus-and-truck-collision-in-Egyp.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**[[West Africa]]n regional bloc [[Economic Community of West African States|ECOWAS]] announces a [[no-fly zone]] over [[Niger]]. [https://www.channelstv.com/2023/07/30/just-in-ecowas-imposes-no-flight-zone-on-niger-republic/ (Channels TV)]
**ECOWAS threatens to "take all measures necessary", including the [[use of force]], to reinstate the government of [[Niger]] if ousted [[President of Niger|president]] [[Mohamed Bazoum]] is not released and reinstated within a week. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20230730-ecowas-set-to-meet-on-niger-coup-leaders-say-bloc-planning-military-intervention (AFP via France 24)]
**The [[National Council for the Safeguard of the Homeland|military junta regime]] warns against any [[Interventionism (politics)|foreign intervention]] in the country, saying that "we want to once more remind ECOWAS, or any other adventurer, of our firm determination to defend our homeland". [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/west-african-leaders-meet-over-niger-coup-junta-warns-against-intervention-2023-07-30/ (Reuters)]
**[[President of Chad|Chadian president]] [[Mahamat Déby]] visits [[Niamey]] in order to meet with [[Government of Niger|Nigerien government]] officials to address the crisis. [https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/30/07/2023/chad-president-in-capital-of-coup-hit-niger-source (AFP via ''The Peninsula'')]
*[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Government of Ukraine|Ukrainian officials]] announce that a [[Peace process|peace summit]], aimed at addressing the invasion, will take place in [[Jeddah]], [[Saudi Arabia]], in early August with representatives from 30 countries expected to attend. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-ukraine-saudi-arabia-talks-ee8719ebcd6a0a541ce6a8670ae6bb09 (AP)]

'''Law and crime'''
*One person is killed and eight others are critically injured in a mass shooting in the [[West Side, Chicago|West Side]] of [[Chicago]], [[Illinois]], [[United States]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/07/30/us/chicago-mass-shooting-west-side/index.html (CNN)]
*Five people are injured, two critically, in a mass shooting at a shopping center in [[Lansing, Michigan|Lansing]], [[Michigan]], United States. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/07/30/us/lansing-shooting-michigan-logan-square/index.html (CNN)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2023 Central African constitutional referendum]]
**Citizens of the [[Central African Republic]] vote in a [[referendum]] that could remove the [[President of the Central African Republic|presidential]] term limit. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/central-africa-vote-referendum-could-extend-touaderas-rule-2023-07-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[2023 Nigerien coup d'état]]
**Thousands of pro-[[Abdourahamane Tchiani|Tchiani]] [[political demonstration|demonstrators]] protest outside the [[France|French]] embassy in [[Niamey]], [[arson|setting fire to]] the door and defacing a plaque. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/07/30/Thousands-protest-outside-French-embassy-in-Niger-Capital-over-aid-suspension (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
*[[Protests against the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Anti-war movement|Anti-war]] activists protest in [[Belgrade]], [[Serbia]], after two prominent anti-war and [[Opposition to Vladimir Putin in Russia|anti-Putin]] activists experienced problems trying to enter the country. [https://apnews.com/article/serbia-russia-ukraine-antiwar-activists-ban-ceae2d6107914002a3542ab51665e8b8 (AP)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 UCI Women's World Tour]]
**[[2023 Tour de France Femmes]]
***[[Sport in the Netherlands|Dutch]] [[Cycle sport|cyclist]] [[Demi Vollering]] of [[SD Worx]] wins the second edition of the [[Tour de France Femmes]] with a dominant stage win over fellow Dutchwoman [[Annemiek van Vleuten]] of [[Movistar Team (women's team)|Movistar Team]] on the [[Col du Tourmalet]] in the [[Pyrenees]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2023/07/30/sport/demi-vollering-tour-de-france-femmes-spt-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2023 FIFA Women's World Cup]]
**[[Morocco women's national football team|Moroccan]] [[Defender (association football)|defender]] [[Nouhaila Benzina]] becomes the first [[football player]] to compete in a senior-level [[International competitions in women's association football|international]] tournament while wearing a [[hijab]], following the overturning of a [[FIFA]] ban on [[Head scarf|head coverings]] in 2014. [https://apnews.com/article/womens-world-cup-south-korea-morocco-benzina-0d2f7f6210260c781c67d82ee702371a (AP)]
